title: Forty lids, from above
logline: The boxes from above, straight down, forty lids in rows, the numbers, the register lines, the pup on Box 1 again as a small shape. The count, drawn as a floor plan.

panels.composition: Straight down onto forty cardboard box lids arranged in rows on a garage floor and along a wall, numbered, pencilled lines on the newer ones, an old three-legged dog curled on the first.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a straight-down view of forty numbered cardboard box lids arranged in rows on a garage floor with pencilled lines on the newer ones and an old three-legged dog curled on the first, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The count as a floor plan.
